- The PDF report (redacted where appropriate)

Jon — thanks for the note and the RedTeam summary. We take RA-03 seriously. High level: we believe the root cause is a set-cookie path/secure attribute combination in our legacy auth redirect flow; the runtime team has implemented a fix that prevents cookie replay across subpaths and denies malformed session tokens at the load balancer.

Quick answers:
- We will upload a redacted PDF of our internal findings and the patch diff by EOD Friday (2026-12-18).
- ETA to close in your tracker: 2026-12-18 with artifacts. If validation by your team requires more time, we can schedule a 30-min review on Monday.
- I'm looping in Irene (security) to attach logs and Karthik (engineering owner) to confirm the PR/CI evidence.

Would you prefer the patch/PR link plus CI run, or a combined bundle (PDF + logs)? We can do both.

—Aditya Rao
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Jon / team,

Thanks for the report. Quick remediation status and artifacts we are providing:

1) Patch/PR: PR #482 (patch-pr-482.diff) — introduces strict SameSite and Secure cookie attributes for the auth cookie, normalizes redirect handling, and adds a validation layer in the edge LB to drop replayed tokens. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/482 (public internal link redacted for this bundle).

2) CI evidence: Successful CI run with integration test that simulates replay attempts (log snippet attached). File: session-replay-log-snippet.txt — redacted timestamps and IPs.

3) Audit artifact: We generate a short PDF summary of the remediation and include the redacted penetration report. File: acme_pt_report_RA-03.pdf (annotated).

ETA and next steps:
- We have deployed the fix to the staging cluster (canary) as of 2026-12-16 22:40 UTC.
- Full rollout to prod scheduled for 2026-12-18 04:00 UTC (completed).
- We expect to provide the full evidence bundle (annotated report + PR diff + log snippets + CI artifact) by 2026-12-18 23:59 UTC.

If you need signed attestation or a short screencast of the test run, we can produce that by next week.

Attachments included in this reply: patch-pr-482.diff (text), session-replay-log-snippet.txt (txt), acme_pt_report_RA-03.pdf (annotated).

Thanks,
